source: Tool names and descriptions from the official Linear MCP server as listed at https://www.speakeasy.com/product/mcp-gateway/catalog/linear (31 tools) and https://docs.nomic.ai/docs/core/mcp-servers/linear. save_issue parameters from the public schema listing (glama.ai, linear-mcp-lean). All other parameter schemas are RECONSTRUCTED from the tool descriptions and Linear's documented object model: names are plausible, not verbatim. Linear's own tools/list needs OAuth (https://mcp.linear.app/mcp) and was not reachable here. Replace with a real tools/list snapshot when a Linear workspace is connected.

tools.name: save_issue
tools.description: Create or update a Linear issue. If `id` is provided, updates the existing issue; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `title` and `team` are required. Note: use `assignee` (not `assigneeId`) to set the assignee — it accepts a user ID, name, email, or "me".

id.description: Issue id or identifier to UPDATE; omit to create

team.description: Team name or id (required on create)

state.description: Workflow state name or id (e.g. In Progress)

blockedBy.description: Issue identifiers/ids that block this issue

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about an issue by ID, including attachments and git branch name

id.description: The issue ID or identifier (e.g. LIN-123)

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues in the user's Linear workspace. For my issues, use "me" as the assignee. Use "null" for no assignee.

query.description: Search query matched against issue title and description

assignee.description: User name or id, "me", or "null" for no assignee

limit.description: Maximum number of issues to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: list_issue_statuses
tools.description: List available issue statuses in a Linear team

tools.name: list_issue_labels
tools.description: List available issue labels in a Linear workspace or team

team.description: Team name or id; omit for workspace labels

limit.description: Maximum number of labels to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: save_comment
tools.description: Create or update a comment on a Linear issue. If `id` is provided, updates the existing comment; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `issueId` and `body` are required.

id.description: Comment id to UPDATE; omit to create

issueId.description: The issue ID or identifier to comment on (required on create)

parentId.description: Parent comment id when replying in a thread

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments for a specific Linear issue

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects in the user's Linear workspace

query.description: Search query matched against project name

state.description: Project state, e.g. planned, started, completed

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific project in Linear

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Create or update a Linear project. If `id` is provided, updates the existing project; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `name` and at least one team (via `addTeams` or `setTeams`) are required.

id.description: Project id to UPDATE; omit to create

addTeams.description: Team names or ids to add to the project

setTeams.description: Team names or ids that replace the project's teams

tools.name: list_milestones
tools.description: List all milestones in a Linear project

tools.name: save_milestone
tools.description: Create or update a milestone in a Linear project. If `id` is provided, updates the existing milestone; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `name` is required.

id.description: Milestone id to UPDATE; omit to create

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List teams in the user's Linear workspace

query.description: Search query matched against team name

limit.description: Maximum number of teams to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific Linear team

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: Retrieve users in the Linear workspace

query.description: Search query matched against user name or email

team.description: Team name or id to filter members

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in the user's Linear workspace

query.description: Search query matched against document title

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to return

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Retrieve a Linear document by ID or slug

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new document in Linear

project.description: Project name or id to attach the document to

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Update an existing Linear document

project.description: Project name or id to move the document to

tools.name: search_documentation
tools.description: Search Linear's documentation to learn about features and usage
